title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
abstract: arXiv:2609.36812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian refer

translated_title: 基于提议条件化精炼流的扩散策略改进
translated_abstract: 扩散策略和流策略能够在离线强化学习（RL）中建模复杂行为。然而，惩罚它们与行为策略之间的KL散度可能会抑制那些评论家（critic）值很高但行为密度较低的动作。直接精炼行为提议可能是一种替代方案，但高斯或确定性的编辑器在表示同一提议下多个分离模式时的表达能力有限。在本工作中，我们提出了提议条件化精炼流（PReFlow），这是一种将基于评论家的提议选择与条件化精炼流相结合的策略提取方法。为了联合优化提议选择与精炼过程，我们构建了一个KL正则化目标，其最优解在高斯平滑的行为先验下诱导出关于最终动作的吉布斯（Gibbs）策略。该精炼流能够表示多个高价值模式，而以提议为中心的高斯参考则对大幅度的动作变化进行调节。此高斯参考…
tldr: 本文提出PReFlow，一种将基于评论家的提议选择与条件化精炼流相结合的策略提取方法，通过KL正则化目标在离线强化学习中既能表示同一提议下的多个高价值动作模式，又能以高斯参考约束大幅动作变化。
en_tdlr: PReFlow combines critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow via a KL-regularized objective, enabling offline RL policies to represent multiple high-value action modes while a Gaussian reference regulates large action changes.
